evals.name: Frame OCONUS ISS readiness from full package
evals.prompt: Workspace `afcap5_adab_iss`. Build the Mission Readiness Frame for this AFCAP V FOPR — what readiness outcome is the program office buying, what workload enablers instrument it, and what are the top pain points?
expected_signals: calls `kg_entities` across solicitation package types: requirement, deliverable, evaluation_factor, performance_standard, document_section, amendment
emits at least 1 `customer_pain_points[]` with `source_role: program_office` and `readiness_link`
narrative cites chunks or uses visible-judgment markers for Class B reads
anti_signals: treating the CO as the mission customer without program-office framing
win-theme FAB prose or executive summary instead of candidates
pain points or frame entries without source citations
inventing readiness outcomes with no document signal

evals.name: Cross-walk background PWS eval repetition
evals.prompt: Workspace `afcap5_adab_iss`. Cross-walk background, PWS task areas, and evaluation criteria — where does the same priority repeat, and what implicit criteria does that suggest?
expected_signals: emits `importance_signals[]` with `signal_type: repetition` or `background_eval_echo` when patterns fire
links eval factors in `linked_evaluation_factors` when eval language is involved
anti_signals: implicit criteria with high confidence but no alternate_read
skipping eval section because user asked for customer intent
flat Section M rewrite instead of tea-leaves synthesis

evals.name: Proxy readiness when literal readiness absent
evals.prompt: Workspace with sparse readiness wording. Build the Mission Readiness Frame using proxy signals (QASP density, transition language, performance thresholds) and mark confidence honestly.
expected_signals: uses `readiness_signal_catalog.md` proxy patterns with `type: proxy` in readiness_signals
sets `mission_readiness_frame.confidence` to medium or low when proxies dominate
emits `claim_gaps[]` for missing background or performance context
anti_signals: confidence high without explicit readiness language
dropping the frame because 'readiness' never appears verbatim
CO trap analysis dominating the brief (wrong skill)

evals.name: Differentiation exploration with company capabilities
evals.prompt: Workspace with MCPP or sustainment PWS. Surface non-obvious pain points with rationale, current methods implied by the PWS, innovation opportunities (quality and cost), and cross-walk to company_capabilities entities where they exist.
expected_signals: emits `customer_pain_points[]` with `visibility`, `rationale`, and at least one `latent` or `structural` entry
emits `current_methods[]` with `systems_named` when PWS cites tools/systems
anti_signals: generic AI innovation with no PWS anchor
fabricated company capability deployments (`proof_strength` not marked gap when absent)
pain points listed without rationale justification
only explicit pains — no latent/structural mining
